headerDisplay: Watches a Switcher Power Plug over your LAN and exposes HomeKit sensors when a laundry cycle finishes. Set deviceId + deviceIp on each plug so watts are polled over TCP (recommended). The main tile is Running.
footerDisplay: HomeKit per device: Running (occupancy, main) — on while the machine draws sustained power. Done (contact) — opens when a cycle finishes and stays open until the next cycle starts or you clear it (use for notifications). Empty Me (optional switch) — turns on with Done; turn it off after you emptied the machine to clear Done.

token.title: Switcher token (optional)
token.description: From https://switcher.co.il/GetKey/ — only needed if TCP poll login requires a token on your firmware.

pollSeconds.title: TCP poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to ask each plug for watts over TCP when deviceId + deviceIp are set.

identifier.title: Switcher identifier
identifier.description: Device id, IP address, or exact name from the Switcher app / Switcher Platform logs.

deviceId.title: Device ID (required for TCP)
deviceId.description: Hex id from Switcher Platform logs (e.g. e4eaf6). Required for washer and dryer when Switcher Platform is installed.

deviceIp.title: Device IP (required for TCP)
deviceIp.description: Plug IP from Switcher Platform logs. Required together with Device ID.

deviceKey.title: Device key (TCP login)
deviceKey.description: Optional. Copy device_key from Switcher Platform logs (e.g. 04 or 05). If empty, laundry learns it from UDP broadcasts.

showEmptySwitch.title: Show Empty Me switch
showEmptySwitch.description: Optional. When a cycle finishes, turns this switch on so you remember to empty the machine. Turn the switch off after emptying to clear Done.

startWatts.title: Start threshold (W)
startWatts.description: Power must stay at or above this value to count as a real cycle start.

stopWatts.title: Stop threshold (W)
stopWatts.description: Power must stay at or below this value before the cycle can finish.

startSeconds.title: Start confirm (seconds)
startSeconds.description: How long power must stay high before marking the washer as running.

stopSeconds.title: Stop confirm (seconds)
stopSeconds.description: How long power must stay low after running before marking the washer as done. Use longer than fill/rinse pauses.
